notes.title: Achievements for Burn Me Alive are now available on Steam. Go hunting!
notes.content:
[h1][b]general information[/b][/h1]

 If you are new to Steam or somehow unfamiliar with the concept of achievements, let us explain it briefly. Achievements are optional, complete objectives with different conditions that relate to your progress, style, certain stages in the game, etc. They can be obtained by fulfilling the necessary conditions. When the achievement condition is met, you will see a special toast on Steam indicating which achievement you just earned.

You can later display this achievement on your Steam profile to show how good you are at Burn Me Alive, or to brag to your Steam friends who have not yet earned this achievement. And of course, don't forget the unique feeling when you have 100% of the achievements! 

There are currently 8 achievements available in Burn Me Alive. They are closely related to game progress, so you can get them by actively playing and investigating all the secrets of the protagonist.

notes.title: Best horror game to play right now
notes.content:
[h2][b]Burn Me Alive[/b][/h2] One of the best horror games ever made, this will scare you in incredibly clever ways and make you question everything you see.

[previewyoutube=wZawXSu5A_k;full][/previewyoutube]

The events of the game take place back in 1977, an era of hippies, punks, and rampant vandalism in Tennessee. The main character of the game is Henry Gray, who lost his family in a terrible fire. Unable to come to terms with grief, he decides to live with his dog and work as a watchman at the same cemetery where his wife and son are buried to be closer to his beloved family. One late night, Henry was awakened by the barking of a dog. Despite the fatigue and a terrible hangover, he goes outside to check what angered the dog so much and finds a strange note, which suggests that he can change the situation and return the family, but for this, he needs to perform a certain ritual.
